sources.title: Arch sync · Oct 8
sources.text: Siddhi decided on October 8 to switch this project to Google one-tap sign-in to reduce sign-in friction.

sources.title: One-tap sign-in backend
sources.text: The one-tap sign-in backend was approved for production on October 10. This approval covers infrastructure readiness; it does not set a user-facing rollout date.
